_comment: Reply-to-vote polls. Each email may carry the newest open poll; people answer by replying to the email with one of the option keys. A routine with Gmail read access tallies the replies, closes the poll and writes results here; the next email prints them once and marks them announced. One vote per sender address, and the latest reply from an address is the one that counts.

polls[].question: the question, one sentence
polls[].options: [{key, label}] - key is the one word people reply with
polls[].closes: YYYY-MM-DD - tallied on the first run on or after this date
polls[].subject: the subject line of the email that asked it, so replies can be found
polls[].results: {<key>: count} once closed, plus voters (count) and invalid (count)
polls[].announced: true once an email has printed the results
polls[].thread_id: Gmail thread id of the send, where replies land

polls.question: Game of the week is a pick'em. Who wins it, wesley55 or bradyrife?
polls.subject: DFFL Week 4: The Lines, and What Every Game Is Worth
